title: A LLM-Based Ranking Method for the Evaluation of Automatic Counter-Narrative Generation
measurement_description: The paper measures the quality of automatically generated counter-narratives against religious hate speech, with a specific focus on Islamophobia and hate speech targeting Jewish people.
findings: The paper's proposed LLM-based ranking method (using JudgeLM) for evaluating counter-narratives correlates highly with human preferences (Spearman's ρ of 0.88), significantly outperforming traditional metrics like ROUGE-L and BLEU. In the task of generating counter-narratives against hate speech, which prominently features religious hate speech, the chat-aligned model Zephyr in a zero-shot setting was found to be the most effective, surpassing even the gold-standard human-written references.
